user.title: Connect Four
user.description: Choose the people in Home Assistant who will play. Each pair gets its own game, so everyone can play against everyone at the same time.

notify.title: Push notifications
notify.description: Pick the phone (mobile app) that should be notified when it is each player's turn. Choose — for no notifications.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Connect Four is already set up. Use Configure to change the players.

invalid_players.message: Choose two different players who take part in Connect Four.

not_playing.message: There is no game in progress.

not_your_game.message: You can only play in your own games.

not_your_settings.message: You can only change your own notifications.

start.name: Start game
start.description: Start a new game (or a new round). When called by a logged-in player, that player challenges the opponent.

player.name: Player
player.description: Only needed when the caller is not a player (e.g. a shared tablet).

drop.name: Drop piece
drop.description: Drop the current player's piece in a column.

resign.name: Resign
resign.description: Give up the game. With fewer than two pieces played the game is cancelled without points.

reset_scores.name: Reset scores
reset_scores.description: Remove all games, series and points (admin only).

set_notifications.name: Set notifications
set_notifications.description: Turn push notifications on or off. A logged-in player changes their own; otherwise name the player.
